description: Registration through _tool/_resource (so every tool and widget gets the error wrapper) is held only by a comment; no test checks every registered tool went through _tool_errors.
_tool and _resource return Any, discarding the ParamSpec typing _tool_errors carries.
No test sends a non-dict, non-None _meta to pin the fail-closed branch of _request_metadata.
Full error text asserted through a real client for four registrations only; a tool added with plain @mcp.tool would pass the surface test.
Wrapping every crash as ToolError means the 2.x SDK logs it at INFO without a traceback.
